name: proxmox-mcp
description: Read-only Proxmox VE and Backup Server CLI that tells you, across every client cluster, which guests have a good, verified, recent restore point and which do not.

proxmox_api_token.title: PROXMOX_API_TOKEN
proxmox_api_token.description: Proxmox VE API token as USER@REALM!TOKENID=SECRET (e.g. monitor@pve!agent=<secret>); the CLI sends it as PVEAPIToken=...

proxmox_host.title: PROXMOX_HOST
proxmox_host.description: Proxmox VE host name or IP (port 8006).

proxmox_pbs_api_token.title: PROXMOX_PBS_API_TOKEN
proxmox_pbs_api_token.description: Optional. Proxmox Backup Server API token as USER@REALM!TOKENID:SECRET (colon before the secret); needed only for pbs-* commands and PBS columns

proxmox_pbs_host.title: PROXMOX_PBS_HOST
proxmox_pbs_host.description: Optional. Proxmox Backup Server host, host:port, or https://host:port (default port 8007).

proxmox_tls_fingerprint.title: PROXMOX_TLS_FINGERPRINT
proxmox_tls_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the PVE certificate to pin (stock Proxmox is self-signed); shown under the node's Certificates.

proxmox_pbs_tls_fingerprint.title: PROXMOX_PBS_TLS_FINGERPRINT
proxmox_pbs_tls_fingerprint.description: Optional. SHA-256 fingerprint of the PBS certificate to pin.

proxmox_base_url.title: Proxmox VE API base URL (optional)
proxmox_base_url.description: Full PVE API base such as https://pve1:8006/api2/json; overrides PROXMOX_HOST. Leave blank to use PROXMOX_HOST.

proxmox_cluster.title: Default cluster (optional)
proxmox_cluster.description: Name of the clusters.toml entry to use by default (same as --cluster). Leave blank to run across every configured cluster.

proxmox_clusters_file.title: clusters.toml path (optional)
proxmox_clusters_file.description: Path to the clusters.toml that lists client clusters. Leave blank for the default in the config directory. Multi-cluster needs each cluster's token variables in the server's environment, which this prompt form cannot set: use the manual JSON config in mcp-install.md for that.

proxmox_user_agent.title: User-Agent header (optional)
proxmox_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Proxmox requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own.

proxmox_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP server (optional)
proxmox_mcp_read_only.description: Set to 1 to drop the sync, export, workflow archive and learnings forget/reject MCP tools. The learning-store tools (teach, playbook) still write locally. Proxmox itself is never written either way. Leave blank for the full tool set. Preset to 1; clear it only when you want the agent to run the tools this switch hides.

proxmox_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token (optional)
proxmox_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote or hosted deployment); the server refuses to start without it. Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (unused - leave blank)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Leave blank. This connector registers no tenant-gated profile source, so the value is read but changes nothing; select client clusters with PROXMOX_CLUSTER or clusters.toml instead.
